notes: Downstage 1.4: PUMP IT, a one-knob bus compressor built into the master — a gentle glue to the left, a squashed mix that pumps on the kick to the right, its gain-reduction meter on the strip and in the full master; the mixing assistant can switch it in and set it. A new demo song, “Kreuzberg”: Berlin synth-pop at 118 BPM in 24 channels, every sound synthesised, mixed with groups, VCAs, effects, outboard, amps, PUMP IT, rides, takes and notes. The guide in six languages describes everything with new screenshots: stereo channels in one slot, the input monitor switch, the new top bar, the built-in templates.
